prediction_input.conversion: For each frame: if min < -0.1 apply (x+1)/2, otherwise use x; multiply by 255, clip to [0,255], truncate to uint8. This matches the pinned VMem tensor_to_pil branch.

reference_input.conversion: torch float32 /255; area resize to 576x768 with antialias=false; crop x=[96,672); multiply by 255, clip, truncate to uint8

denominator: Every channel value of all four 576x576 RGB targets; no pixel or frame exclusion
aggregate: Sum integer numerators and denominators over all four targets before division
future_access: Future RGB is opened only after the prediction seal. Future depth and pose are not opened by this metric.
claim_boundary: This is a development RGB reconstruction score. It is not a geometry score, held-out result, memory gain, method benefit, or novelty evidence.
